Marta (Marketing): thinking about a 60m webinar on 'Latency & Ledger: Practical tricks for cost-effective LLM inference' — goal is practical takeaways, 2 demos, and a short benchmark walk-through. Thoughts on speakers and run order?
Ethan (DevEx): love it. can do a live demo of batching + kv-cache optimizations. ~8-10 min.
Lina (Speaker Ops): we should lock speakers by EOD Wed. who’s primary and who’s backup? also need 2 rehearsals (tech + full run)
Raj (Product): I can present the routing/fallback policy piece — 7min. quick customer story + metrics.
Marta (Marketing): tentative lineup: intro (Marta) 5m, Raj product 7m, Ethan demo 10m, customer case 8m, panel q&a 20m, close CTA 5m. That leaves ~5m buffer. ok?
Ethan (DevEx): buffer good. For demos: primary is hosted API latency/cost tradeoff. fallback demo: Dedicated capacity cold-start behavior. need infra access privs for the greenroom.
Lina (Speaker Ops): rehearsal slots: Thurs 9am (tech check, 30m) and Fri 11am (full run, 50m). please mark availability. greenroom-bot will send invites once Marta confirms.
greenroom-bot: rehearsal invites queued. please acknowledge when you RSVP.
Raj (Product): flagged — need a short one-slide handoff showing SLA/latency numbers for the panel. will drop slide in #marketing-assets by tomorrow.
Marta (Marketing): audience routing: we’ll use two tracks for registrants: "startup/dev" (demo-heavy) and "enterprise/platform" (SLA + private deploy use cases). Lina — routing rules?
Lina (Speaker Ops): simple form tag routing. I'll set lead routing: >500 monthly tokens -> AE follow-up, demo opt-in -> product-led touch. will share mapping doc.
Ethan (DevEx): tech checks: ensure streaming enabled, function-calling mock registered, and demo keys have rate limits. paste small checklist in channel.
Marta (Marketing): checklist items: recording on, captioning enabled, backup recording local, slack channel for stage ops, failover slides if demo goes down.
Raj (Product): +1 to failover slides. also propose a canned prompt set for benchmark walk-through (3 prompts: short, mid, long).
Lina (Speaker Ops): copy. I'll run a dry-run with speakers and confirm mic/camera. can everyone ACK availability Thurs/Fri?
Ethan (DevEx): ACK Thu 9am, Fri 11am.
Raj (Product): ACK both.
Marta (Marketing): ACKs noted. Lina — ping greenroom-bot to confirm invites and add run-of-show doc link. I'll draft the landing page copy today. :sparkles:
Lina (Speaker Ops): will do. putting run-of-show in #marketing-assets in 30m. thanks! :thumbsup:
